note: Adversarial-framing check was applicable (the day's lead Regional story names Saudi Arabia in a geopolitical/security context: the Red Sea maritime coalition and a prepared offensive against the Houthis). The check was run against Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye and Iranian state media (Press TV/Tasnim/Tehran Times/Mehr). Al Jazeera's in-window pieces were neutral/explanatory; MEE's Saudi-blockade coverage and Iranian state media's hostile items were all dated 24-29 July (out of window). One in-window adversarial framing was found (Antiwar.com, 30 July, citing a Houthi official casting Saudi Arabia as the escalating aggressor) and is carried in Negative Articles. Separately, an in-window human-rights item (BBC, 30 July, the Ahmed al-Doush case) was surfaced by RSS pre-filter and web search and is also carried in Negative Articles. No watchdog/NGO published a Saudi-specific item dated 30-31 July.
